meta.objective: Harden judge-gym infra for V4 launch by moving Media Cloud acquisition to the Temporal execution plane, validating full smoke/screen coverage, clearing irrelevant Convex and Railway state, and simplifying Railway bootstrap/linking so contributors can provision the stack from scratch.

notes: Convex own-dev deployment is combative-pika-662 and is healthy after a prior greenfield reset.
Railway project sincere-freedom is linked again, includes Temporal template services plus Redis and engine-temporal-worker, and the latest worker deployment was verified running.
Media Cloud acquisition currently runs inside Convex node actions rather than in engine-temporal, which is misaligned with the user's desired execution ownership model.
Local V4 canary tooling and paper-audit bundle builders already exist under scripts/v4 and can be reused for smoke validation once runtime ownership is corrected.

current.label: temporal_owned_acquisition_with_clean_bootstrap
current.summary: Media Cloud acquisition now runs on the Temporal worker, live acquisition smoke passes, transient own-dev state is cleared after proof, and the Railway bootstrap path is documented and scriptable without hidden service knowledge.

workflowRuns.requestedObjective: Compile the first infra-hardening workflow: move Media Cloud acquisition from Convex actions into engine-temporal, define the smallest trustworthy smoke ladder for local and live validation, and identify the exact cleanup/bootstrap changes needed before V4 launch operations.

bottlenecks: The remaining work is no longer infra hardening; it is launch-side experiment/canary execution.
A custom Railway template still does not exist, so the official Temporal template remains the starting point for new projects.

decisions.statement: Treat this workspace as infra-only; V4 launch execution is explicitly out of scope until infra is hardened.
Use engine-temporal, not a new microservice, as the execution home for Media Cloud acquisition.
Keep bun dev agent-owned and use it as the local observability spine throughout the campaign.
Accept bounded page-budget controls in Media Cloud discovery so live acquisition smokes can prove the real path without paging into avoidable rate-limit noise.
